rationale: Keyed sibling anchors in native browser-capture lowering: a data-pulp-key unique among its siblings spells its anchor segment tag[key=<key>] so a reorder carries stored edits with the node; duplicate keys fall back to ordinals and are reported. Pulp-owned; watch-only, no authority change.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'a duplicated sibling key is reported'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'a keyed list item keeps its anchor'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'a keyed list reorder plans moves'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'an unkeyed list reorder plans rewrites'
